text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hatsumode, wooo! Let's go worship this 
godlike god and hit 'em with a happy new 
year!
choice_data_list:
You're getting pretty used to party lingo, 
huh.

You're getting pretty used to party lingo, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's been quite a while since I last 
saw my BFF, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Senior year is finally here starting this 
year! Guess it's about time to drop some 
electric, party-peeps moves in front of 
the whole crowd!

All the achievements built up until now. 
And Oguri Cap's powerful run seen at the 
end of the year...

Her various experiences became her 
strength, and this year Mejiro Palmer 
looks ready to shine just as she pleases.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, by the way, Trainer. Something just 
popped into my head~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you're wishing like a party person, 
wouldn't it be better to pray to a "Party 
God" instead of a regular god?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yup! There's plenty of party-animal gods 
among Umamusume out there, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Is it okay if we check that one out too? 
Wanna take a quick trip over?"
choice_data_list: I see, that could be interesting.
I see, that could be interesting.

text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps instead of an old-fashioned 
god, they'll grant me a more modern power.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's go meet them then. ...Though I guess 
party gods come in all shapes and sizes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Party animals who know how to play hard, 
or party animals blessed with god-tier 
looks... Who do you wanna go worship?

The countless party gods. If I'm going to 
worship them this New Year's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios's goddess...? Oh, come to think of 
it, my bestie has an Umamusume who gives 
off divine, blinding vibes to her, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Someone was given the cold shoulder before 
and yelled, "Milady's so salty~!" What was 
their name again...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Dainichi Nyorai... or something? Was that 
it? Anyway, let's go pay our respects!

Dainichi Nyorai... Sounds like quite a 
divine name, but I wonder what it looks 
like?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there she is! Could that girl be... 
Facebook!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what? That looks nothing like a 
Nyorai! So cute...! Like a doll!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we try going over to talk to 
them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, this is at maximum cuteness, 
it's almost intimidating. Let's just look, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... She's so nice~ Just looking at her 
kinda feels good for the soul...

The two of us admired her appearance from 
afar. It was truly an adorableness that 
healed both body and soul.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The progenitor of party animals... Come to 
think of it, I heard the very first party 
animal existed a pretty long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Among all those, the original classic has 
gotta be...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yappie, Palmer-chan! Let's-a-dancing♪ 
Cha-cha, cha, cha! Wooo!!

—Maruzensky. A high-energy Umamusume who 
loves the retro, bubbly culture of the 
Showa era.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So, what do you want to get-chu from me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san. I was kind of hoping you 
could teach me some original groovy 
slang...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The original party vibe...? Well, let's 
see— straight bangs, bodycon dresses, 
Shonan lovers!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Go, go! Woo-hoo, shining bright! Pay with 
arcade tokens and wear your sweater like a 
producer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I don't know what it means, but 
that's intense. I see, so this is the 
original party animal slang...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I think I'm starting to feel 
aggressive too! Let's keep the pressure 
on!

Gazing upon Maruzensky's gorgeously bubbly 
visage seemed to give Mejiro Palmer a 
boost of confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A God of Billiards... I see, so party gods 
can be the cool, stylish type too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well then, why don't we go take a peek at 
the billiards place?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so you're the one who wants me to 
teach you how to play billiards, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. Th-This is a totally different 
kind of party animal...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Billiards is all about tactics. Let 'em 
shoot how they like, then finish them off 
at the end. But—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I don't like that sort of thing. I'd 
rather push relentlessly on the offense 
without ever handing over a turn. You like 
that kind of style too, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's with this flow? Am I just 
supposed to blindly obey, or what?

"Sirius Symboli, master of self-centered 
billiards. Mejiro Palmer learned various 
push techniques from one of the party gods 
(?)."
